author: theworldisbananas
body: Omg, taquitos from old town is the taste of my childhood. I’m taking my kids to the states for the first time soon and can’t wait for them to try all my childhood memories. The middle child says she wants to try Chipotle, and I asked what she wants to try there. “I want to get a burrito” you can’t even imagine how hard I rolled my eyes, as someone who grew up in SoCal. I replied “really? Chipotle for Mexican food is so mid”….. eyes rolled in response.
